decision.thesis: No entry. (1) THE L-007 FORECAST FIRED, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE EXPERIMENT THE ROLLED-FORWARD WINDOW WOULD HAVE FLIPPED THE SPAN SCREEN FROM FAIL TO PASS. The 02:00 note forecast that the 16:15Z bar (1.074%) would leave the 3h window at ~19:15Z and the 5h window at ~21:15Z, both before this check, that 18:00Z-01:00Z is the quietest stretch of the day, and that on a quiet stretch N would collapse toward ~0.10-0.20% and the required span fall to ~0.39-0.64% - a 4.4x to 7.2x loosening with nothing printing - UNLESS a new impulse bar printed. IT WAS CONFIRMED: N(full preceding hour) = 0.237% (the 01:00Z bar), inside the predicted band. BINDING N IS 0.327%, STATED BEFORE THE ROLLED-FORWARD VALUE - the 09-24 22:15Z bar, which made the 2676.02 low that the entire long structure rests on. Required span on the binding N = 2.5N + 0.14% = 0.9575%; on the rolled-forward N(1h) it would be 0.7325%. The long's available span is 0.8864%. AGAINST THE HONEST WINDOW IT FAILS BY 0.0711pp; AGAINST THE ROLLED-FORWARD WINDOW IT WOULD PASS BY 0.1539pp. The difference between a refusal and a permission is purely which window N was measured over, and nothing structural printed to cause it. Every prior instance of L-007 inflated a ratio or made a stop look noise-safe; this is the first that would have converted a refusal into an entry. SIXTH consecutive confirmed forecast. Stated, not scored - the clock is the review's call. (2) L-001: ALL FIVE CONTRACTS REMAIN EXCLUDED, every binding print re-verified UNREVISED at 5m/1h/4h/daily - BTCUSDT 09-21 08:00Z 4h H95,804.10 (17.392% range = 19.04x the 0.9133% 4h median; 09-21 daily 18.161% = 7.96x) for a 27th check; SOLUSDT 09-22 16:00Z 4h L106.67 (11.175% = 7.04x, wick/body 15.7; 09-22 daily w/b 31.0) plus a ~234-313x 24h quote-volume shortfall (423.8M against 99.1-132.8 BILLION) for a 17th check; XRPUSDT 09-23 04:00Z 4h H1.6855 (w/b 40.6, rm 2.25x) and the 09-23 daily bar at rm 2.71x; BNBUSDT 09-24 00:00Z 4h H780.90 UNCHANGED at w/b 20.5; ETHUSDT 09-21 08:00Z 4h H2850.00 (7.221% = 5.27x). NEW THIS CHECK, AND IT TIGHTENS: BNBUSDT ACQUIRED A SECOND 4h FLAG - the 09-24 16:00Z bar, O780.70 H786.18 L776.64 C780.02, w/b 14.0, carrying the new 24h high 786.18. The 02:00 note predicted 'four distinct mechanisms have moved a BNB reading while 780.90 stands - expect a fifth'; the fifth is a NEW flag at a HIGHER price, so BNB stays caught even after 780.90 leaves the 4h window at 09-25 20:00Z. RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST: 786.18 flags on wick/body alone (rm only 0.96x) because its body is 0.087% - a small body inflates the ratio mechanically, which is the same weakness the review recorded against ETH's citation. It changes nothing, because BNB is excluded on 780.90 regardless. ALSO RECORDED: this check's daily scan again flags ETHUSDT's 09-21 daily bar (7.885% = 2.53x the 3.1154% median, carrying H2850.00), reproducing the daily half of L-001's ETH citation for a SECOND consecutive check after three checks recorded it as not reproducible. The standing note forbids resolving the empty set from a check - P-011 puts that with Edward. (3) THE TWO FORECAST BARS BOTH CLOSED AND BOTH MOVED - AND THE FORMING-BAR TRAP IS DEMONSTRATED A THIRD TIME. The 09-24 16:00Z 4h bar CLOSED O2682.25 H2699.39 L2660.49 C2694.09: ABOVE the 02:00 note's 2682.25 'recovery continues' threshold, nowhere near its 2640.00 threshold, and it made a NEW high 2699.39 above the 2698.06 that had stood unchanged for three checks. That bar read C2676.00 at the 00:00 check, C2662.20 at the 02:00 check and CLOSED at C2694.09 - three different answers inside one bar, the final one 31.89 points above the last forming read. Both predecessors were right to refuse it a reading. The 09-24 DAILY bar CLOSED O2684.16 H2699.39 L2633.31 C2686.59, ABOVE the 09-23 close of 2684.16: the falling daily-close sequence 2775.61 -> 2752.43 -> 2684.16 did NOT extend to four - IT BROKE, the first higher daily close in four days. (4) trend IS NOW CLAIMABLE LONG, AND IT IS THE ONLY CATEGORY - THE GATE READS ONE FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE CHECK AND THE SINGLE CATEGORY HAS SWITCHED SIDES. Four consecutive higher 4h lows: 2633.31 -> 2640.00 -> 2660.49 -> 2676.02, plus the broken daily-close sequence. L-006 re-measurement: these are CLOSED-BAR prices the market actually made, not rolling-window statistics, so the claim survives - unlike every window-derived figure refused below. AGAINST INTEREST: the last closed 4h bar (09-24 20:00Z) is itself a lower high and a lower close (H2695.78 < 2699.39, C2686.59 < 2694.09), so the long trend claim rests on lows and the daily close, not on highs. THE GATE HAS NOW READ 3 -> 0 -> 1 -> 1 ON ETHUSDT ACROSS FOUR CONSECUTIVE HOURLY CHECKS, AND BETWEEN THE LAST TWO THE SURVIVING CATEGORY FLIPPED DIRECTION: 02:00 carried price_action SHORT alone, this check carries trend LONG alone. It is not merely never two - it is not even consistently one side. (5) price_action NOT CLAIMED IN EITHER DIRECTION, AND THE 02:00 SHORT PREMISE IS FALSIFIED BY THE MARKET. That check claimed price_action short on a failed breakout and seven consecutive lower highs (2697.65 > 2691.95 > ... > 2669.61); price then rallied and made a NEW high at 2699.39, so THE LOWER-HIGH SEQUENCE IS BROKEN and the short's only category is gone. A long claim would need a break of 2699.39, which has not happened - the level has now rejected three times (2699.39, then 2695.78, then 2695.62/2695.01). Higher lows compressing under a thrice-rejected ceiling is a coil, which is not directional evidence for either side. (6) volume NOT CLAIMED - AND THE L-006 RE-MEASUREMENT RAN THE OTHER WAY THIS TIME, WHICH IS RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST. At 02:00 the 100-bar median was INFLATED by quiet Asian hours and re-measurement DISSOLVED the claim. Here the 100-bar median (322,623,493) is HIGHER than the honest session median (248,297,996, -23.0%), so re-measuring against the setup-containing window makes the up-impulses look BIGGER, not smaller: 00:05Z 4.93x and 01:00Z 3.31x against 3.80x and 2.55x on the 100-bar window. This is a re-measurement that SURVIVED and pointed toward claiming, not away. It is refused anyway, on the strategy's own definition: 'expansion on the move, drying up on the pullback'. THE PULLBACK DID NOT DRY UP - the SECOND-LARGEST bar of the entire session is the 22:15Z DOWN bar at 3.77x the session median, and it is the bar that made the 2676.02 low the long rests on. 11 of 19 up bars (58%) and 6 of 15 down bars (40%) sit above the session median, a separation far too weak to carry a category on 34 bars. The 02:00 note's instruction that volume is the category to distrust on this host is applied in full. (7) derivatives NOT CLAIMED - OI IS THE FIELD THAT MATTERS AND IT IS STILL FLAT. Funding settled at 09-25 00:00Z as forecast; next settlement 09-25 08:00Z. ETHUSDT +0.009096% - a THIRD consecutive unclamped reading (+0.009626% -> +0.009225% -> +0.009096%), answering the 02:00 note's test YES. BTCUSDT did NOT stay snapped to its cap: +0.007025% against exactly +0.010000% one check earlier, so only ONE of five is now on a bound (BNBUSDT at 0.000000%), down from two; SOLUSDT +0.004047%, XRPUSDT +0.003071%. ETHUSDT OI 11,897,688,432 against 11,887,027,055 at 02:00 = +0.090%, FLAT. Funding alone has never carried derivatives here. (8) market_context NOT CLAIMED - ETH IS A LAGGARD, WHICH OPPOSES THE ONLY CLAIMED CATEGORY. 24h: BTC +0.357%, ETH +0.475%, BNB +1.468%, SOL +2.169%, XRP +3.555%. BTC crossed back ABOVE zero from -0.165%, but the 02:00 check measured ~three quarters of its previous crossing as 24h reference-price roll and the same contamination applies to this one, so the crossing is not read as a market event. ETH is FOURTH OF FIVE for a second consecutive check - relative weakness, which cuts AGAINST the long that trend supports. Recorded against the check's own candidate. (9) L-004 - THE SPAN SCREEN FAILS AND THE TWO CONDITIONS ARE DISJOINT FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE CHECK, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. LONG at ask 2695.00 with the structurally honest stop below the 2676.02 higher low (2675.50): risk 0.7236% = 2.21x N, genuinely noise-safe. The NEAREST valid target is 2699.39 itself; anything above it - the next structure is 2718.09/2727.77 - is reachable only by JUMPING a level that has rejected three times in nine hours, which L-004 forbids outright. Reward to 2699.39 is 0.1629%, so gross RR 0.225 and NET RR ~0.03 after the ~0.14% round-trip drag. Span available 0.8864% against 0.9575% required: FAILS by 0.0711pp, stated against the setup-containing window and stated first. SHORT at bid 2694.99 with the honest stop above 2699.39 (2700.00): risk 0.1859% = 0.57x N, SUB-NOISE, refused outright by L-002 - and it is precisely that sub-noise stop which generates the only floor-clearing number of the check, net RR 3.03 to the nearest support 2676.02. THE ONLY CONSTRUCTION THAT CLEARS 1.5 DOES SO ON A 0.57x N STOP; THE ONLY CONSTRUCTION WITH A NOISE-SAFE STOP PAYS 0.03 NET. The two conditions do not overlap anywhere, and no entry price rescues that because moving the entry moves them in opposite directions. To make the short's stop noise-safe it would have to sit above ~2703.6, a price with no structure of any kind. (10) L-005 - FIVE SWEEPS, AND THE FIRST THREE-CONSECUTIVE-SWEEP FAILURE OF THE EXPERIMENT. Maximum order notional 2,500 USDT. BTCUSDT's BID failed on sweeps 3, 4 AND 5 - 76.17 -> 253.85 -> 84.59 USDT, 10x to 33x smaller than one maximum order, with NO recovery observed before the check ended. L-005 records adjacent PAIRS as the rare form; this is a TRIPLE. ETHUSDT's ASK - the exact side this check's only claimable candidate, a long, would have to cross - printed 29.64 USDT at sweep 2 and 26.95 USDT at sweep 4, 84x and 93x smaller than one maximum order, THE TWO SMALLEST ETH CROSSED-SIDE PRINTS OF THE EXPERIMENT (the previous record was 40.3 USDT on 09-24 at 16:00), while quoting 3.08 and 2.04 bps. BNBUSDT's bid printed 7,727 USDT at sweep 1 and 31.15 USDT at sweep 5 with its ask at 16,722 on the same sweep; SOLUSDT lost its ask at sweep 3 (8.24 USDT), its bid at sweep 4 (8.24 USDT) and its ask again at sweep 5 (37.67 USDT). XRPUSDT was the ONLY contract healthy on both sides across all five sweeps - recorded against interest, and it is a contract excluded on artifact grounds. THE 25 bps CAP FIRED ZERO TIMES; the widest spread of the entire check was 15.294 bps (SOLUSDT, sweep 2), on the check where a bid printed 8.24 USDT. EIGHTEENTH consecutive check with the cap blind to the finding (P-009). LESSONS APPLIED: L-001 at 5m/1h/4h/daily plus cross-contract - all five prints re-verified unrevised, a NEW BNB 4h flag recorded (tightening), the ETH 09-21 daily flag reproduced for a second consecutive check, and the weakness of a small-body wick/body flag recorded against interest on 786.18. L-002 with binding N = 0.327% stated BEFORE the rolled-forward 0.237%; the short's 0.57x N stop refused outright despite being the only construction to clear the floor; tally NOT advanced - no construction was both noise-safe and floor-clearing, so nothing was resolved - stands at ONE OF THREE. L-003 applied with five sweeps; no construction survived L-002/L-004 to be requoted, consistent with the recorded finding that L-003 has never been a sole reason to refuse; clock ZERO. L-004 applied FIRST and as a refusal to compute, the 0.0711pp miss stated against the setup-containing window and stated first, and the 2718.09/2727.77 targets refused on target validity for jumping a thrice-rejected 2699.39. L-005 applied with five sweeps, the first THREE-consecutive-sweep failure on record, and the two smallest ETH crossed-side prints of the experiment on the exact side the candidate long must cross. L-006 applied to every window-derived figure: it REFUSED market_context and the BTC zero crossing, CONFIRMED trend as closed-bar structure rather than window arithmetic, and - recorded against interest - RAN TOWARD claiming on volume rather than away, the first time re-measurement has strengthened a candidate category; volume was refused on the strategy's own definition instead. L-007 forecast CONFIRMED for a sixth consecutive check, and for the first time the rolled-forward figure would have flipped the span screen from fail to pass. No lesson was loosened, reinterpreted, retired or overridden; no rule or risk limit was relaxed. Nothing under 05-交易记录-data/reviews/ was read for modification or modified.
